parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-21 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 27.0 | 38.35 | 38.35
2 | 28.6 | 3.21 | 41.56
3 | 27.8 | 26.07 | 67.63
4 | 30.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-21
Curve type: KH-type
Aquifer depth: 41.56 - 67.63 m
Recommendation: Target the third layer for potential water production. Ensure a minimum drilling depth of 68 m is reached.
